game_title: Split Join Assembly – Frozen Waterfall Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall, a frozen waterfall: the rescue climber must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Frozen Waterfall: a frozen waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Waterfall, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the assembly value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the radio mast using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the radio mast is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 5 (applied tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Frozen Waterfall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Frozen Waterfall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The radio mast reached with actions_used <= 20.
